title: Vibe-Coding Is Killing Your AI Productivity - Benedikt Stemmildt | code.talks 2025
summary: Live demo of a configured Claude Code workflow (subagents, TDD, CLAUDE.md, MCP) vs vibe coding, plus PM/dev prototyping collaboration.

assertions.quote: our main agent ... is not polluting its context window with stuff that's not relevant

verdicts.note: Subagents return summaries rather than raw exploration; Anthropic reports gains from multi-agent research, at higher token cost.

assertions.quote: implement a test first um a red test because we are doing test driven development

verdicts.note: Tests-first gives agents a target and limits test-cheating; evidence is mostly anecdotal and it does not suit all code (e.g. UI).

assertions.quote: research ... to figure out how to implement this the right way not the wipe coded way

verdicts.note: Plan-then-execute consistently reduces agent rework in practice and in vendor evals, especially on multi-file tasks.

assertions.quote: if I add 10 MCP tools here my context is already full

verdicts.note: Each MCP server injects tool schemas into context; large servers can use tens of thousands of tokens, and agents use CLIs well. Deferred tool loading has since reduced this.

assertions.quote: so that it follows your idea of of good software engineering practices

verdicts.note: Persistent instruction files measurably steer agent behavior; overlong or contradictory ones reduce adherence.

assertions.quote: what is relevant? ... That's why this feature is not working very well

verdicts.note: Fresh context avoids accumulated noise, but compaction is useful when state is hard to reconstruct; it is a tradeoff, not a rule.

assertions.quote: the sub agent is kind of like a new person, right? A new context, fresh eyes

verdicts.note: Fresh-context reviewers avoid self-confirmation and context bloat; plausible and commonly practiced but little hard evidence.

assertions.quote: prototyping, vip coding, totally very good to do that, but do it in a way that you know this is not your production code

verdicts.note: Unreviewed AI-built apps commonly ship with security, scaling and maintainability problems; prototypes are their sweet spot.
The 47-source review finds evidence strongest for prototyping and UI work and weakest for production. The break-down half is mostly unstudied, not shown.

assertions.quote: you kind of guard railed it down to a very specific way of doing something

verdicts.note: Vendors advise removing over-prescriptive instructions as models improve; but guardrails still prevent real failures. Plausible, weakly evidenced.

assertions.quote: we would have figured out that the user doesn't want that at all and already stopped

verdicts.note: Validating demand before building is long-standing product practice; AI lowers prototype cost, making it more attractive.

Vibe coding is said to support 'rapid prototyping and early validation of ideas', and the review advises using it mainly for prototyping and exploration unless validation is strong; user validation of requirements is not studied.

assertions.quote: I don't really like these frameworks ... I take the ideas and put it into into our own team's workflow

verdicts.note: Owning and understanding your workflow helps you debug it, and many practitioners report framework bloat; but there is no comparative evidence, and frameworks can be a good starting point.
